title: Home page
desc: The public front door of PMC Managers. Visitors see what the platform does, the latest live tenders and the main ways in: Find tenders, Register as a supplier and Sign in.

title: Public tender board
desc: Every published tender with its reference, buyer, category, country and closing date. Anyone can search and filter; bidding needs a verified supplier account.
actions: Filter by category, country and closing date
Open a tender to read the documents

title: Notice board
desc: Published notices and corrigenda in date order, so suppliers can see changes to live tenders.
actions: See corrigenda issued against a tender

title: For suppliers
desc: Explains how suppliers register, get verified, find tenders, bid with sealed envelopes and get paid through escrow.

title: For buyers
desc: Explains how buyers publish tenders, set criteria, run sealed openings and award with a full audit trail.

title: Sign in
desc: One sign-in page for every user. Choose your role first: Supplier, PMC staff, Admin, Escrow institution or Partner. Each role opens its own portal.

title: Supplier registration
desc: New suppliers create an account with company details. After email verification they complete KYC; PMC checks it before the supplier can bid.
actions: Complete KYC in the supplier portal

title: Admin dashboard
desc: The control room. Attention cards show tenders closing this week, drafts awaiting approval and bids awaiting EMD. 'Live tender progress' shows every live tender's stage line (criteria, bids, opening, proof review, price, L1, award) so stalled tenders stand out.
actions: Click an attention card to jump to the list
Open a tender from Live tender progress

title: Notices
desc: All tenders (draft and live). Each row has the progress tracker, Criteria, View, Edit/Corrigendum and Preview. Draft rows show the 'Ready to publish?' checklist (document, dates, a must-pass criterion) with its own Publish button.
actions: New notice (the Criteria window opens after Create)
Criteria: set what bidders must meet
Publish once the checklist is all ticked

title: Criteria window
desc: Sets the tender's criteria. Add from the Criteria master or a whole set, read them from the tender document with AI, or add your own. Each criterion is pass/fail or scored, Mandatory or optional, with proof required or not. Also set the minimum optional criteria, consortium rules and how the winner is picked (L1 or weighted).
actions: + Add from master / a criteria set

title: Tender builder
desc: Builds the tender document. Clone a master template or use 'AI generate from DPR' to draft a tender from a project report. Drafts have a Criteria button and 'Create notice' to turn the draft into a notice (criteria come across).

title: Criteria master
desc: The library every tender picks criteria from. Build master criteria and named sets such as 'Standard construction'. Admins and reviewers can edit; removing archives (nothing is deleted).

title: Corrigenda
desc: Changes to live tenders. Each corrigendum is dated, described and sent to every bidder and follower.

title: BOQ & contracts
desc: Bills of quantities and contract documents linked to tenders.

title: Vendors
desc: Every registered supplier with KYC status, categories and activity.

title: Registrations
desc: New supplier registrations waiting for KYC review. Approve, ask for clarification or reject with a reason.

title: Partners
desc: Partners who onboard suppliers and earn commission. Unfinished profiles show 'N of 4 sections complete'. Edit details opens the full 5-section form; resend the invite link; approve.

title: Bidding ops
desc: Runs the bid opening. Each tender with a committee shows the opening card: who has signed, blockers, technical opening, the system qualification check with AI proof findings and committee accept/reject, price opening, the automatic L1 ranking and 'Award to L1'.

title: Escrow / EMD
desc: Bid deposits (EMD) and award payments held in escrow, with dual-signed releases and consortium payment instructions.
actions: Record consortium member payouts and bank references

title: Evaluation
desc: Committee scoring rubric and the Award recommendation report, which follows the tender's rule (L1 or weighted).

title: L1 comparison
desc: Ranks qualified bids by price (L1, L2, L3) with compliance flags. Runs automatically after price opening and can be re-run here.

title: Awards
desc: Awarded bids with award letters, contracts and signatures.

title: Reverse auctions
desc: Live reverse auctions where invited suppliers bid prices down within a time window.

title: Permissions
desc: Who can do what. Roles and the approval matrix that decides each bid's sign-off order.

title: Governance & integrity
desc: Committees, conflict-of-interest declarations and integrity checks.

title: Tender review
desc: Reviewers approve tenders prepared by suppliers before they can be published.
actions: Approve or send back a supplier-prepared tender

title: Masters
desc: Reference data: staff accounts, categories, countries, currencies and other lists used across the platform.

title: Audit ledger
desc: Every action is recorded in a tamper-evident chain. Verify chain re-checks every link.

title: Billing
desc: Hosting fees, subscriptions and invoices.

title: Events & alerts
desc: System events and alerts, including scheduled jobs and email delivery.

title: Supplier dashboard
desc: The supplier's home: matching tenders, open bids, notices and messages.

title: Tenders for you
desc: Tenders matching the supplier's categories, with closing dates.

title: Prepare a bid
desc: The bid form: technical documents, the Criteria section (each item marked Mandatory or Optional, with the rule for optional criteria), proofs, price and EMD. Everything is sealed when submitted.
actions: Answer every mandatory criterion and attach proofs

title: My bids
desc: All of the supplier's bids with status, criteria result notices and award documents.

title: Consortia
desc: Consortium invitations, teams, shares, agreement signatures and member payouts.
actions: See your payout and bank reference

title: EMD & payments
desc: Bid deposits paid into escrow and refunds.

title: Company profile & KYC
desc: Company details, documents and KYC. Some figures here (like turnover) pre-fill criteria answers.

title: Prepare tender (supplier)
desc: Verified suppliers can prepare tenders for buyers; they go to PMC review before publishing.

title: Partner profile
desc: Partners complete four sections (profile, banking, documents, agreement) with a progress bar; the form opens where they left off. After approval they onboard suppliers and see commission.

title: Staff portal (committee)
desc: Committee members and other staff see their tasks: tenders to open, proofs to review, bids to sign off and award.
